title: Blue Eye Samurai Confirms Final Season Release With New Season 2 Trailer
content: In 2023, Netflix created one of the most critically acclaimed animated series to ever arrive on the streaming service: Blue Eye Samurai . While a second season has been known to arrive on the platform for some time, many fans were wondering what the future would hold for Mizu and her quest for vengeance.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu 2nd Season' Reveals New Staff, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yu So-nan and Uk-jakga 's Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu ( A Returner's Magic Should Be Special ) manhwa revealed new staff and the first promotional video for its second season on Friday. The anime will air in October 2026 every Thursday at 12.45 a.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special 2nd Season Anime's 1st Promo Video Streamed
content: The staff for the second season of the anime based on Wookjakga 's A Returner's Magic Should Be Special ( Kikansha no Mahō wa Tokubetsu Desu in Japanese) Korean webtoon revealed its first promotional video on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Kakao Games Announces The World of Dokkaebi MMORPG Based on Web Novel With October Launch
content: Kakao Games announced on August 6 that it will launch Supercat's The World of Dokkaebi , a new MMORPG based on the web novel Chronicles of the Demon-Slaying Cultivator , in October. The World of Dokkaebi combines 2D pixel-art characters with 3D environments and draws on Korean folklore and Eastern fantasy.
author: ANN

title: 'Ore to Yuu-nii!' Reveals Additional Staff, Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content: Production company DMM pictures opened an official website for a televsion anime adaptation of Miyuki Nakayama 's Shota Oni boys love manga revealed additional staff and a teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Seiji Kishi Directs Maiden Blood Original TV Anime at Polygon Pictures
content: Pony Canyon revealed on Friday that director Seiji Kishi will direct a new original television anime series titled Maiden Blood that will debut in 2027. Pony Canyon said it will announce international release details at a later date. The dark fantasy action anime will star Iori Saeki as Eva and Yukari Anzai as Epica.
author: ANN

title: Tanuki to Kitsune TV Anime Reveals Visual, October 4 Debut
content: Frontier Works announced on Friday that the television anime based on Atamoto 's Tanuki to Kitsune (Raccoon Dog and Fox) manga will debut on October 4. The anime will air within the "Animori" program that airs on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on Sundays at 7:00 a.m.
author: ANN

title: Original TV Anime 'Maiden Blood' Announced for 2027
content: Production company Pony Canyon opened an official website for the Maiden Blood original television anime on Friday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Magical Girl Raising Project restart Anime Debuts on October 5
content: Hiroyuki Hashimoto returns from the first Magical Girl Raising Project anime as the director. Takao Yoshioka is returning to write the script. Masako Itou ( Magical Girl Raising Project SD character designer) is designing the characters for the new anime based on original designs by Maruino .
author: ANN

title: Ore to Yu Nii! TV Anime Debuts in January 2027, Reveals Teaser Promo Video
content: DMM Pictures revealed a teaser promotional video and the January 2027 debut on Friday for Ore to Yu Nii! (Me and Older Brother Yu), the television anime based on Miyuki Nakayama 's Shota x Oni (or Shota Oni ) boys-love manga . The video reveals the anime will debut in January 2027, and also reveals more staff.
author: ANN
